<!--[0--><div class="SVELTE_HYDRATER contents" data-target="Hydrater" data-props="{&quot;targetSelector&quot;:&quot;.model-card-content&quot;}"><!----></div> <div class="model-card-content prose md:px-6 md:-mx-6 lg:-mr-20 lg:pr-20 xl:-mr-24 xl:pr-24 2xl:-mr-36 2xl:pr-36 hf-sanitized hf-sanitized--0MFcv2B8uVB1HfzyOv-3 copiable-code-container"><!--[-1--><!--]--> <!----><h1 align="center">FlagEmbedding</h1>


<h4 align="center">
    <p>
        <a href="#model-list" rel="nofollow">Model List</a> | 
        <a href="#frequently-asked-questions" rel="nofollow">FAQ</a> |
        <a href="#usage" rel="nofollow">Usage</a>  |
        <a href="#evaluation" rel="nofollow">Evaluation</a> |
        <a href="#train" rel="nofollow">Train</a> |
        <a href="#contact" rel="nofollow">Contact</a> |
        <a href="#citation" rel="nofollow">Citation</a> |
        <a href="#license" rel="nofollow">License</a> 
    </p><p>
</p></h4>

<p>More details please refer to our Github: <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding" rel="nofollow">FlagEmbedding</a>.</p>
<p>If you are looking for a model that supports more languages, longer texts, and other retrieval methods, you can try using <a href="https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-m3" rel="nofollow">bge-m3</a>.</p>
<p><a href="/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5/blob/main/README.md" rel="nofollow">English</a> | <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/blob/master/README_zh.md" rel="nofollow">中文</a></p>
<p>FlagEmbedding focuses on retrieval-augmented LLMs, consisting of the following projects currently:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Long-Context LLM</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/Long_LLM/activation_beacon" rel="nofollow">Activation Beacon</a></li>
<li><strong>Fine-tuning of LM</strong> : <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/LM_Cocktail" rel="nofollow">LM-Cocktail</a></li>
<li><strong>Dense Retrieval</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/BGE_M3" rel="nofollow">BGE-M3</a>, <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/llm_embedder" rel="nofollow">LLM Embedder</a>, <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/baai_general_embedding" rel="nofollow">BGE Embedding</a></li>
<li><strong>Reranker Model</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/reranker" rel="nofollow">BGE Reranker</a></li>
<li><strong>Benchmark</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/C_MTEB" rel="nofollow">C-MTEB</a></li>
</ul>
<h2 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="news" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#news" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		News
	</span>
</h2>
<ul>
<li>1/30/2024: Release <strong>BGE-M3</strong>, a new member to BGE model series! M3 stands for <strong>M</strong>ulti-linguality (100+ languages), <strong>M</strong>ulti-granularities (input length up to 8192), <strong>M</strong>ulti-Functionality (unification of dense, lexical, multi-vec/colbert retrieval). 
It is the first embedding model which supports all three retrieval methods, achieving new SOTA on multi-lingual (MIRACL) and cross-lingual (MKQA) benchmarks.
<a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/blob/master/FlagEmbedding/BGE_M3/BGE_M3.pdf" rel="nofollow">Technical Report</a> and <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/BGE_M3" rel="nofollow">Code</a>. :fire:</li>
<li>1/9/2024: Release <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/Long_LLM/activation_beacon" rel="nofollow">Activation-Beacon</a>, an effective, efficient, compatible, and low-cost (training) method to extend the context length of LLM. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.03462" rel="nofollow">Technical Report</a> :fire:</li>
<li>12/24/2023: Release <strong>LLaRA</strong>, a LLaMA-7B based dense retriever, leading to state-of-the-art performances on MS MARCO and BEIR. Model and code will be open-sourced. Please stay tuned. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.15503" rel="nofollow">Technical Report</a> :fire:</li>
<li>11/23/2023: Release <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/LM_Cocktail" rel="nofollow">LM-Cocktail</a>, a method to maintain general capabilities during fine-tuning by merging multiple language models. <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.13534" rel="nofollow">Technical Report</a> :fire:  </li>
<li>10/12/2023: Release <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/llm_embedder" rel="nofollow">LLM-Embedder</a>, a unified embedding model to support diverse retrieval augmentation needs for LLMs. <a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.07554.pdf" rel="nofollow">Technical Report</a></li>
<li>09/15/2023: The <a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2309.07597.pdf" rel="nofollow">technical report</a> of BGE has been released </li>
<li>09/15/2023: The <a href="https://data.baai.ac.cn/details/BAAI-MTP" rel="nofollow">massive training data</a> of BGE has been released </li>
<li>09/12/2023: New models: <ul>
<li><strong>New reranker model</strong>: release cross-encoder models <code>BAAI/bge-reranker-base</code> and <code>BAAI/bge-reranker-large</code>, which are more powerful than embedding model. We recommend to use/fine-tune them to re-rank top-k documents returned by embedding models. </li>
<li><strong>update embedding model</strong>: release <code>bge-*-v1.5</code> embedding model to alleviate the issue of the similarity distribution, and enhance its retrieval ability without instruction.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<details>
  <summary>More</summary>

    
<ul>
<li>09/07/2023: Update <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/blob/master/FlagEmbedding/baai_general_embedding/README.md" rel="nofollow">fine-tune code</a>: Add script to mine hard negatives and support adding instruction during fine-tuning. </li>
<li>08/09/2023: BGE Models are integrated into <strong>Langchain</strong>, you can use it like <a href="#using-langchain" rel="nofollow">this</a>; C-MTEB <strong>leaderboard</strong> is <a href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/mteb/leaderboard" rel="nofollow">available</a>.  </li>

<p>[1]: If you need to search the relevant passages to a query, we suggest to add the instruction to the query; in other cases, no instruction is needed, just use the original query directly. In all cases, <strong>no instruction</strong> needs to be added to passages.</p>
<p>[2]: Different from embedding model, reranker uses question and document as input and directly output similarity instead of embedding. To balance the accuracy and time cost, cross-encoder is widely used to re-rank top-k documents retrieved by other simple models. 
For examples, use bge embedding model to retrieve top 100 relevant documents, and then use bge reranker to re-rank the top 100 document to get the final top-3 results.</p>
<p>All models have been uploaded to Huggingface Hub, and you can see them at <a href="https://huggingface.co/BAAI" rel="nofollow">https://huggingface.co/BAAI</a>. 
If you cannot open the Huggingface Hub, you also can download the models at <a href="https://model.baai.ac.cn/models" rel="nofollow">https://model.baai.ac.cn/models</a> .</p>
<h2 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="frequently-asked-questions" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#frequently-asked-questions" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Frequently asked questions
	</span>
</h2>
<details>
  <summary>1. How to fine-tune bge embedding model?</summary>

  
<p>Following this <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/examples/finetune" rel="nofollow">example</a> to prepare data and fine-tune your model. 
Some suggestions:</p>
<ul>
<li>Mine hard negatives following this <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/examples/finetune#hard-negatives" rel="nofollow">example</a>, which can improve the retrieval performance.</li>
<li>If you pre-train bge on your data, the pre-trained model cannot be directly used to calculate similarity, and it must be fine-tuned with contrastive learning before computing similarity.</li>
<li>If the accuracy of the fine-tuned model is still not high, it is recommended to use/fine-tune the cross-encoder model (bge-reranker) to re-rank top-k results. Hard negatives also are needed to fine-tune reranker.</li>
</ul>
</details>

<details>
  <summary>2. The similarity score between two dissimilar sentences is higher than 0.5</summary>

  
<p><strong>Suggest to use bge v1.5, which alleviates the issue of the similarity distribution.</strong> </p>
<p>Since we finetune the models by contrastive learning with a temperature of 0.01, 
the similarity distribution of the current BGE model is about in the interval [0.6, 1].
So a similarity score greater than 0.5 does not indicate that the two sentences are similar.</p>
<p>For downstream tasks, such as passage retrieval or semantic similarity, 
<strong>what matters is the relative order of the scores, not the absolute value.</strong>
If you need to filter similar sentences based on a similarity threshold, 
please select an appropriate similarity threshold based on the similarity distribution on your data (such as 0.8, 0.85, or even 0.9).</p>
</details>

<details>
  <summary>3. When does the query instruction need to be used</summary>

  

<p>For the <code>bge-*-v1.5</code>, we improve its retrieval ability when not using instruction. 
No instruction only has a slight degradation in retrieval performance compared with using instruction. 
So you can generate embedding without instruction in all cases for convenience.</p>
<p>For a retrieval task that uses short queries to find long related documents, 
it is recommended to add instructions for these short queries.
<strong>The best method to decide whether to add instructions for queries is choosing the setting that achieves better performance on your task.</strong>
In all cases, the documents/passages do not need to add the instruction. </p>
</details>

		Usage for Embedding Model
	</span>

<p>Here are some examples for using <code>bge</code> models with 
<a href="#using-flagembedding" rel="nofollow">FlagEmbedding</a>, <a href="#using-sentence-transformers" rel="nofollow">Sentence-Transformers</a>, <a href="#using-langchain" rel="nofollow">Langchain</a>, or <a href="#using-huggingface-transformers" rel="nofollow">Huggingface Transformers</a>.</p>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-flagembedding" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-flagembedding" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using FlagEmbedding
	</span>
</h4>
<pre><code>pip install -U FlagEmbedding
</code></pre>
<p>If it doesn't work for you, you can see <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/blob/master/FlagEmbedding/baai_general_embedding/README.md" rel="nofollow">FlagEmbedding</a> for more methods to install FlagEmbedding.</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> FlagEmbedding <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> FlagModel
sentences_1 = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-2"</span>]
sentences_2 = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-3"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-4"</span>]
model = FlagModel(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5'</span>, 
                  query_instruction_for_retrieval=<span class="hljs-string">"为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章："</span>,
                  use_fp16=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>) <span class="hljs-comment"># Setting use_fp16 to True speeds up computation with a slight performance degradation</span>
embeddings_1 = model.encode(sentences_1)
embeddings_2 = model.encode(sentences_2)
similarity = embeddings_1 @ embeddings_2.T
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(similarity)

<span class="hljs-comment"># for s2p(short query to long passage) retrieval task, suggest to use encode_queries() which will automatically add the instruction to each query</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># corpus in retrieval task can still use encode() or encode_corpus(), since they don't need instruction</span>
queries = [<span class="hljs-string">'query_1'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'query_2'</span>]
passages = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例文档-1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例文档-2"</span>]
q_embeddings = model.encode_queries(queries)
p_embeddings = model.encode(passages)
scores = q_embeddings @ p_embeddings.T
</code></pre>
<p>For the value of the argument <code>query_instruction_for_retrieval</code>, see <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master#model-list" rel="nofollow">Model List</a>. </p>
<p>By default, FlagModel will use all available GPUs when encoding. Please set <code>os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"]</code> to select specific GPUs.
You also can set <code>os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"]=""</code> to make all GPUs unavailable.</p>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-sentence-transformers" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-sentence-transformers" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using Sentence-Transformers
	</span>
</h4>
<p>You can also use the <code>bge</code> models with <a href="https://www.SBERT.net" rel="nofollow">sentence-transformers</a>:</p>
<pre><code>pip install -U sentence-transformers
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> sentence_transformers <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> SentenceTransformer
sentences_1 = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-2"</span>]
sentences_2 = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-3"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-4"</span>]
model = SentenceTransformer(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5'</span>)
embeddings_1 = model.encode(sentences_1, normalize_embeddings=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>)
embeddings_2 = model.encode(sentences_2, normalize_embeddings=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>)
similarity = embeddings_1 @ embeddings_2.T
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(similarity)
</code></pre>
<p>For s2p(short query to long passage) retrieval task, 
each short query should start with an instruction (instructions see <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master#model-list" rel="nofollow">Model List</a>). 
But the instruction is not needed for passages.</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> sentence_transformers <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> SentenceTransformer
queries = [<span class="hljs-string">'query_1'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'query_2'</span>]
passages = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例文档-1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例文档-2"</span>]
instruction = <span class="hljs-string">"为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章："</span>

model = SentenceTransformer(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5'</span>)
q_embeddings = model.encode([instruction+q <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> q <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> queries], normalize_embeddings=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>)
p_embeddings = model.encode(passages, normalize_embeddings=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>)
scores = q_embeddings @ p_embeddings.T
</code></pre>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-langchain" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-langchain" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using Langchain
	</span>
</h4>
<p>You can use <code>bge</code> in langchain like this:</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> langchain.embeddings <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> HuggingFaceBgeEmbeddings
model_name = <span class="hljs-string">"BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5"</span>
model_kwargs = {<span class="hljs-string">'device'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'cuda'</span>}
encode_kwargs = {<span class="hljs-string">'normalize_embeddings'</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">True</span>} <span class="hljs-comment"># set True to compute cosine similarity</span>
model = HuggingFaceBgeEmbeddings(
    model_name=model_name,
    model_kwargs=model_kwargs,
    encode_kwargs=encode_kwargs,
    query_instruction=<span class="hljs-string">"为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章："</span>
)
model.query_instruction = <span class="hljs-string">"为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章："</span>
</code></pre>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-huggingface-transformers" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-huggingface-transformers" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using HuggingFace Transformers
	</span>
</h4>
<p>With the transformers package, you can use the model like this: First, you pass your input through the transformer model, then you select the last hidden state of the first token (i.e., [CLS]) as the sentence embedding.</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> transformers <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> torch
<span class="hljs-comment"># Sentences we want sentence embeddings for</span>
sentences = [<span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"样例数据-2"</span>]

<span class="hljs-comment"># Load model from HuggingFace Hub</span>
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5'</span>)
model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5'</span>)
model.<span class="hljs-built_in">eval</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment"># Tokenize sentences</span>
encoded_input = tokenizer(sentences, padding=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>, truncation=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>, return_tensors=<span class="hljs-string">'pt'</span>)
<span class="hljs-comment"># for s2p(short query to long passage) retrieval task, add an instruction to query (not add instruction for passages)</span>
<span class="hljs-comment"># encoded_input = tokenizer([instruction + q for q in queries], padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors='pt')</span>

<span class="hljs-comment"># Compute token embeddings</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">with</span> torch.no_grad():
    model_output = model(**encoded_input)
    <span class="hljs-comment"># Perform pooling. In this case, cls pooling.</span>
    sentence_embeddings = model_output[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][:, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>]
<span class="hljs-comment"># normalize embeddings</span>
sentence_embeddings = torch.nn.functional.normalize(sentence_embeddings, p=<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, dim=<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Sentence embeddings:"</span>, sentence_embeddings)
</code></pre>
<h3 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="usage-for-reranker" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#usage-for-reranker" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Usage for Reranker
	</span>
</h3>
<p>Different from embedding model, reranker uses question and document as input and directly output similarity instead of embedding. 
You can get a relevance score by inputting query and passage to the reranker. 
The reranker is optimized based cross-entropy loss, so the relevance score is not bounded to a specific range.</p>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-flagembedding-1" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-flagembedding-1" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using FlagEmbedding
	</span>
</h4>
<pre><code>pip install -U FlagEmbedding
</code></pre>
<p>Get relevance scores (higher scores indicate more relevance):</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> FlagEmbedding <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> FlagReranker
reranker = FlagReranker(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-reranker-large'</span>, use_fp16=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>) <span class="hljs-comment"># Setting use_fp16 to True speeds up computation with a slight performance degradation</span>

score = reranker.compute_score([<span class="hljs-string">'query'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'passage'</span>])
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(score)

scores = reranker.compute_score([[<span class="hljs-string">'what is panda?'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'hi'</span>], [<span class="hljs-string">'what is panda?'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'The giant panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca), sometimes called a panda bear or simply panda, is a bear species endemic to China.'</span>]])
<span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(scores)
</code></pre>
<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="using-huggingface-transformers-1" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#using-huggingface-transformers-1" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Using Huggingface transformers
	</span>
</h4>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> torch
<span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> transformers <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-reranker-large'</span>)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-reranker-large'</span>)
model.<span class="hljs-built_in">eval</span>()

pairs = [[<span class="hljs-string">'what is panda?'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'hi'</span>], [<span class="hljs-string">'what is panda?'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'The giant panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca), sometimes called a panda bear or simply panda, is a bear species endemic to China.'</span>]]
<span class="hljs-keyword">with</span> torch.no_grad():
    inputs = tokenizer(pairs, padding=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>, truncation=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>, return_tensors=<span class="hljs-string">'pt'</span>, max_length=<span class="hljs-number">512</span>)
    scores = model(**inputs, return_dict=<span class="hljs-literal">True</span>).logits.view(-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, ).<span class="hljs-built_in">float</span>()
    <span class="hljs-built_in">print</span>(scores)
</code></pre>

model_ort = ORTModelForFeatureExtraction.from_pretrained(<span class="hljs-string">'BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5'</span>, file_name=<span class="hljs-string">"onnx/model.onnx"</span>)

<span class="hljs-comment"># Tokenize sentences</span>

model_output_ort = model_ort(**encoded_input)
<span class="hljs-comment"># Compute token embeddings</span>

    model_output = model(**encoded_input)

<span class="hljs-comment"># model_output and model_output_ort are identical</span>

<h4 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="usage-via-infinity" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#usage-via-infinity" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Usage via infinity
	</span>
</h4>
<p>Its also possible to deploy the onnx files with the <a href="https://github.com/michaelfeil/infinity" rel="nofollow">infinity_emb</a> pip package.
Recommended is <code>device="cuda", engine="torch"</code> with flash attention on gpu, and <code>device="cpu", engine="optimum"</code> for onnx inference.</p>
<pre><code class="language-python"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> asyncio
<span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> infinity_emb <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> AsyncEmbeddingEngine, EngineArgs

sentences = [<span class="hljs-string">"Embed this is sentence via Infinity."</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"Paris is in France."</span>]
engine = AsyncEmbeddingEngine.from_args(
    EngineArgs(model_name_or_path = <span class="hljs-string">"BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5"</span>, device=<span class="hljs-string">"cpu"</span>, engine=<span class="hljs-string">"optimum"</span> <span class="hljs-comment"># or engine="torch"</span>
))

<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">main</span>(): 
    <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">with</span> engine:
        embeddings, usage = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> engine.embed(sentences=sentences)
asyncio.run(main())
</code></pre>

<h2 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="train" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#train" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		Train
	</span>
</h2>
<h3 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="baai-embedding" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#baai-embedding" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		BAAI Embedding
	</span>
</h3>
<p>We pre-train the models using <a href="https://github.com/staoxiao/RetroMAE" rel="nofollow">retromae</a> and train them on large-scale pairs data using contrastive learning. 
<strong>You can fine-tune the embedding model on your data following our <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/examples/finetune" rel="nofollow">examples</a>.</strong>
We also provide a <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/examples/pretrain" rel="nofollow">pre-train example</a>.
Note that the goal of pre-training is to reconstruct the text, and the pre-trained model cannot be used for similarity calculation directly, it needs to be fine-tuned.
More training details for bge see <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/blob/master/FlagEmbedding/baai_general_embedding/README.md" rel="nofollow">baai_general_embedding</a>.</p>
<h3 class="relative group flex items-baseline">
	<a id="bge-reranker" class="block pr-1.5 text-lg md:absolute md:p-1.5 md:opacity-0 md:group-hover:opacity-100 md:right-full" href="#bge-reranker" rel="nofollow">
		<span class="header-link"><svg class="text-gray-500 hover:text-black dark:hover:text-gray-200 w-4" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" aria-hidden="true" role="img" width="1em" height="1em" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" viewBox="0 0 256 256"><path d="M167.594 88.393a8.001 8.001 0 0 1 0 11.314l-67.882 67.882a8 8 0 1 1-11.314-11.315l67.882-67.881a8.003 8.003 0 0 1 11.314 0zm-28.287 84.86l-28.284 28.284a40 40 0 0 1-56.567-56.567l28.284-28.284a8 8 0 0 0-11.315-11.315l-28.284 28.284a56 56 0 0 0 79.196 79.197l28.285-28.285a8 8 0 1 0-11.315-11.314zM212.852 43.14a56.002 56.002 0 0 0-79.196 0l-28.284 28.284a8 8 0 1 0 11.314 11.314l28.284-28.284a40 40 0 0 1 56.568 56.567l-28.285 28.285a8 8 0 0 0 11.315 11.314l28.284-28.284a56.065 56.065 0 0 0 0-79.196z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span>
	</a>
	<span>
		BGE Reranker
	</span>
</h3>
<p>Cross-encoder will perform full-attention over the input pair, 
which is more accurate than embedding model (i.e., bi-encoder) but more time-consuming than embedding model.
Therefore, it can be used to re-rank the top-k documents returned by embedding model.
We train the cross-encoder on a multilingual pair data, 
The data format is the same as embedding model, so you can fine-tune it easily following our <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/examples/reranker" rel="nofollow">example</a>. 
More details please refer to <a href="https://github.com/FlagOpen/FlagEmbedding/tree/master/FlagEmbedding/reranker" rel="nofollow">./FlagEmbedding/reranker/README.md</a></p>
